text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Morning. Another day begins at Tracen 
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Run along riverbank at dawn to shake off 
drowsiness. Horse girls seen here and 
there—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You're up early. Trainer-san out for run 
too?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, patrolling while taking walk. Many 
students run around here from morning.
choice_data_list:
Already out for students' sake this 
early...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone spend days in good health. 
Seeing everyone smiling.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Being part of those daily lives— For that, 
I would...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Dire straits!! 'Lead Escort-kun No. 2' 
won't stop!!!! Somebody, anybodyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Yasunzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, few eyes around Tracen Academy in 
morning. Time to stealthily... stab new 
acupressure point...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san. Let's both do our 
best today too♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Bringing trouble here will not 
be tolerated!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Not letting you get away today!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet glimpse of Tazuna-san running off 
...felt like she was smiling.
